name: Cloistered Philosopher
body:
By shutting out external distractions, a cuill gains access to an inner peace unique to his race.

Prerequisite(s): Wisdom 15, cuill, Knowledge (history) 1 rank, Knowledge (religion) 1 rank

Benefit(s): A cuill can count his Wisdom as if it were 2 points higher for the purpose of determining his spells known and spells per day.
